channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Legendary Japanese strikeout pitcher Yutaka Enatsu dies at 78
item.description: Enatsu had legendary numbers during his 18-year career with the Hanshin Tigers, Nankai Hawks, Hiroshima Carp, Nippon Ham Fighters and Seibu Lions.

item.title: Takaichi and ASEAN leaders agree to boost energy and supply chain cooperation
item.description: The Japanese prime minister proposed a framework to coordinate emergency releases of oil reserves and plans for an advanced tech common market.

item.title: Japan may revise loan guarantee rules to secure funds for U.S. investments
item.description: Loans covered by Nippon Export and Investment Insurance guarantees are currently considered to carry a lower default risk.

item.title: Japan considering higher taxes on condo flipping as Tokyo prices soar
item.description: The tougher tax measures are expected to curb speculative transactions and will be included in a fiscal 2027 tax system reform package.

item.title: Imran Khan seeks urgent medical care fearing he 'may not return alive'
item.description: Pakistan's ex-prime minister, who has been in prison since August 2023, says he has been denied justice.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
